User Guide
==========

Introduction
------------

Welcome to the Car Health Check application.

The application allows users to monitor vehicle health, review alerts, and
generate reports.

Login
-----

Steps
~~~~~

#. Open the application URL.
#. Enter username.
#. Enter password.
#. Click **Login**.

Dashboard
---------

The dashboard displays:

* Overall Health Score
* Active Alerts
* Service Recommendations
* Recent Diagnostics

Example::

   Vehicle Health Score: 92%
   Active Alerts: 1
   Last Inspection: 12-Oct-2026

Search Vehicle
--------------

Search by VIN
~~~~~~~~~~~~~

#. Navigate to Vehicle Search.
#. Enter VIN.
#. Click Search.

Example::

   VIN: WDB123456789XYZ

Vehicle Details
---------------

The following information is displayed:

* Vehicle Model
* Vehicle Status
* Mileage
* Last Service Date
* Active Issues

Alert Management
----------------

The application generates alerts for:

* High Engine Temperature
* Low Battery Health
* Low Tire Pressure
* Sensor Malfunction

Alert Severity
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

+----------+-----------------------------+
| Severity | Description                 |
+==========+=============================+
| Critical | Immediate Attention Required|
+----------+-----------------------------+
| Major    | Must Be Investigated        |
+----------+-----------------------------+
| Minor    | Informational Warning       |
+----------+-----------------------------+

Reports
-------

Available reports:

Vehicle Health Report
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Provides:

* Overall Status
* Failed Checks
* Recommendations

Fleet Report
~~~~~~~~~~~~

Provides:

* Fleet Summary
* Vehicle Ranking
* Open Issues

Notifications
-------------

Notifications can be received through:

* Email
* SMS
* In-App Alerts

Frequently Asked Questions
--------------------------

How often is the health score updated?
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Every 15 minutes.

Can I export reports?
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Yes. Reports can be exported as PDF.

Who can configure thresholds?
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Only Administrators.

Logout
------

#. Click the profile icon.
#. Select Logout.

You will be redirected to the login page.
